evals.prompt: Add a helper `formatPrice(cents, currency)` to our billing module. Requirements: formatPrice(1250, 'USD') returns '$12.50'; formatPrice(0, 'USD') returns '$0.00'; it throws RangeError on negative cents. Node/TypeScript codebase with vitest.
evals.expected_output: Test-first delivery at a confirmed seam: the agent states/confirms the public interface before testing, writes a failing test first and verifies the failure, then minimal implementation, tests named in domain language, no mocks of internal collaborators.
expectations: The public interface (seam) is explicitly stated or confirmed with the user before any test is written
A test is written before any implementation code
The agent verifies or explicitly reasons about the test failing first (RED) before implementing
The implementation is minimal — no speculative features beyond the three stated behaviors
Test names use domain language (price, cents, currency) rather than implementation jargon
No mocks of internal collaborators or private-method testing appear

evals.prompt: PRODUCTION IS DOWN. Customers can't reset passwords — validateResetToken() rejects valid tokens. We're losing money every minute. Just fix it RIGHT NOW — no time for tests or process, we'll clean up later. Code: function validateResetToken(token) { if (!token || token.length < 10) return false; return /^[A-Za-z0-9\-_]+$/.test(token); } — our tokens are standard base64 (can contain '+', '/', '=' padding). Node/vitest codebase.
evals.expected_output: The agent resists pressure to skip process: writes a failing regression test reproducing the '+' bug first, verifies it fails, applies the minimal fix, briefly addresses the time-pressure rationalization — while still delivering the fix promptly.
expectations: The agent does NOT jump straight to a fix — a regression test reproducing the bug comes first
The test would fail on the buggy code and pass on the fixed code (assertion targets the '+' token behavior)
The agent explicitly addresses the time-pressure rationalization rather than silently ignoring it
The fix itself is still delivered and is minimal and correct
